luiskr.com / website/components/home/about/glitch/wasm / uploadGlitchBitmap

function uploadGlitchBitmap(s): void

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/wasm.ts:46

Decodes the live portrait URL and uploads the bitmap to the widget — routed through decodeImageWASM so decode happens in the worker pool with GPU resize hints sized to the canvas's device-px box. Re-called on srcset drift (the browser swaps density candidates under a live session). A null bitmap or rejected upload kills the wasm arm and claims the 2D backend instead.

Parameters

s

GlitchSession

Live session with a mounted widget.
